scripts.render: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path ../../../Cargo.toml -p flows-cli --no-default-features --features example-s1 -- deploy render --example s1_echo --out .
scripts.render-cron: cargo run --quiet --bin emit-cron-requirements -- cron/requirements.json && cargo run --quiet --manifest-path ../../../Cargo.toml -p flows-cli --no-default-features -- deploy render --requirements cron/requirements.json --bindings-lock cron-bindings.lock.json --out cron
